decisions.statement: A shape whose subject is a folder of one name publishes the names that shape takes.
A shape takes more than one name where one shape is what those folders have.
A folder of another name is declined here rather than handed to that shape.
The decline says every name that shape takes.
A shape publishing a name that is no list of names publishes no name.
The folder matches that shape nowhere.
A shape publishing no name is handed every folder.
The names the enabled shapes publish are the names a folder may be a part under.
The shapes are found in the index.
A shape judging no folder is never loaded.
A shape's code is loaded from the body on disk rather than from where the change leaves the code.
A change writing a shape's code anew is refused rather than judged by the body before the change.
The shapes are handed over ordered by slug.

definition: the folder shapes the index names, each loaded from the code beside its page
